title: Distributed Rate Limiter & Token Bucket Gateway
problemStatement: Multi-tenant APIs frequently experience 'noisy neighbor' spikes and DDoS vectors. Build a low-latency, sliding-window and token-bucket distributed rate limiting proxy that intercepts traffic and coordinates token consumption across a Redis cluster with zero race conditions.
architecture: High-throughput reverse proxy written in Go using atomic Redis Lua scripts to execute sliding window counter increments in < 2ms. Supports gRPC streaming and HTTP middleware headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset).
scaleTargets: Sustain 25,000 req/sec across 4 worker nodes with p99 latency overhead < 3.5ms and 99.99% enforcement accuracy.
verificationRubric: Live deployment or Docker Compose 1-line setup (docker compose up -d)
k6 or Locust benchmark script simulating 25k RPS under concurrent spikes
Redis Lua script preventing check-then-act race conditions under concurrency
Prometheus metrics endpoint exporting dropped vs permitted counter metrics
Comprehensive README with ASCII / Mermaid sequence diagram
portfolioBulletFormula: Engineered distributed rate limiting proxy in Go & Redis using atomic Lua scripts; protected 4 upstream services while maintaining < 3.5ms p99 overhead under 25k RPS load.

title: Real-Time Collaborative Document Canvas
problemStatement: Concurrent document editors suffer from conflict desynchronization and high latency over lossy networks. Build a zero-conflict collaborative whiteboard or markdown editor where remote edits seamlessly converge using Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs).
architecture: React frontend using Canvas API / Yjs state model connected over WebSocket channels to a Node.js sync server. Implements state-based CRDTs with presence awareness (live cursor coordinates, user avatars) and local-first indexedDB offline persistence.
scaleTargets: Seamless synchronization between 10+ concurrent editors per room with < 50ms peer-to-peer broadcast latency and offline-online re-convergence.
verificationRubric: Live deployed demo on Vercel/Render with multi-window link sharing
Offline resilience demo: disconnect Wi-Fi, edit locally, reconnect without data loss
Cursor broadcast with smooth interpolation and color-coded user badges
Test suite verifying CRDT convergence across out-of-order packet delivery
Architecture document explaining operational transformation vs CRDT tradeoffs
portfolioBulletFormula: Architected real-time collaborative editor in TypeScript, React, and WebSockets using Yjs CRDTs; enabled conflict-free multi-user editing with < 50ms broadcast sync and full offline resilience.

title: Event-Driven Payment Reconciliation Engine
problemStatement: Fintech platforms process millions of transaction events across third-party gateways (Stripe, Razorpay, Bank APIs) that often mismatch due to webhook dropped packets, bank settlements, and timezone drift. Build an automated reconciliation engine with idempotent ledger tracking.
architecture: Kafka consumers ingest raw gateway webhooks into an append-only transaction ledger in PostgreSQL. A reconciliation worker runs interval matrix joins detecting pending, settled, and discrepant transactions, emitting webhook alerts on discrepancy anomalies.
scaleTargets: Reconcile 500,000 transaction pairs in under 3 minutes with exactly-once idempotency and 100% discrepancy detection precision.
verificationRubric: Dockerized test environment with simulated mock banking settlement feeds
Idempotency key enforcement preventing double-credit on retried webhooks
Automated discrepancy reporting generating downloadable CSV/PDF audit trails
Unit tests with 90%+ branch coverage validating out-of-order webhook ingest
PostgreSQL schema designed with double-entry bookkeeping constraints
portfolioBulletFormula: Built event-driven payment reconciliation system in Python & Kafka backed by PostgreSQL; matched 500k daily transaction events with 100% precision and zero-loss idempotency.

title: Distributed In-Memory Cache with Eviction & Sharding
problemStatement: High-throughput applications exhaust traditional database connections without localized caching layers. Build a custom multi-threaded in-memory key-value cache engine in Rust supporting consistent hashing sharding and pluggable eviction policies (LRU / LFU).
architecture: Rust async network server using Tokio and custom lock-free or striped concurrent hash maps. Implements TCP custom binary protocol with consistent hash ring node discovery and background TTL tombstone sweeps.
scaleTargets: Achieve 80,000 read operations/sec per thread with memory footprint under 64MB and p99 read latency < 800 microseconds.
verificationRubric: Cargo benchmark suite showing throughput comparisons against Redis baseline
Thread safety proven via Rust borrow-checker and stress tests with 100 threads
Consistent hashing visualization script illustrating re-balancing upon node leave/join
Pluggable eviction policy trait implementation for LRU, LFU, and FIFO
CI workflow running cargo clippy, cargo test, and memory sanitizers
portfolioBulletFormula: Designed high-performance concurrent key-value cache in Rust using Tokio; achieved 80k ops/sec with sub-millisecond p99 latencies using custom consistent hashing and LRU eviction.

title: Multi-Tenant B2B Event Analytics Engine
problemStatement: SaaS analytics products struggle to query billions of clickstream events in real-time without costly batch compute. Build an analytical ingestion pipeline that streams client telemetry into ClickHouse with instant aggregations.
architecture: HTTP telemetry ingestion worker queues JSON beacons into Kafka topics. Kafka-ClickHouse engine tables batch write columnar rows into partition-backed MergeTree tables. A GraphQL/REST API queries funnels, retention cohorts, and time-series aggregations in real time.
scaleTargets: Ingest 10,000 events/sec while serving 95% of aggregate dashboard queries in < 100ms over 10M+ recorded events.
verificationRubric: ClickHouse MergeTree schema with primary keys tuned for date-partitioning
Simulated traffic generator streaming 1M events into the ingestion pipeline

portfolioBulletFormula: Implemented multi-tenant telemetry pipeline using Kafka and ClickHouse; delivered sub-100ms dashboard aggregations over 10M+ events with an 8x data compression ratio.

title: Full-Stack Headless E-Commerce with Optimistic UI
problemStatement: Traditional e-commerce carts suffer from high bounce rates due to checkout latency, inventory overselling, and slow page re-renders. Build a modern headless storefront with optimistic cart updates, database lock-guarded inventory checkout, and Stripe webhook verification.
architecture: Next.js App Router frontend with server components and Zustand/React Query client state. Backend REST/RPC endpoints use PostgreSQL `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` row locks to prevent overselling inventory during concurrent flash-sale checkouts.
scaleTargets: Sub-150ms page load times, 100% inventory oversell prevention under 500 concurrent checkout requests, and 100 Lighthouse performance score.
verificationRubric: Live Vercel deployment with functioning Stripe test-mode checkout flow

portfolioBulletFormula: Developed full-stack headless commerce platform with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Stripe; eliminated inventory overselling via row-level locking under 500 concurrent checkout attempts.

title: Internal Developer Platform & GitOps Container Pipeline

scaleTargets: Provision complete preview environments in < 90 seconds, automatically de-allocating pods upon pull request merge or 24-hour inactivity.

scaleTargets: Query latency < 450ms across 50,000 embedded document chunks with 95% citation recall accuracy and complete offline fallback mode.

title: High-Throughput Log Processing & Alerting Daemon

architecture: Spring Boot ingestion service that reads batched log payloads from Kafka, normalizes unstructured log lines using high-speed regex pattern matchers, caches rolling error counts in Redis, and bulk indexes records into Elasticsearch.

portfolioBulletFormula: Engineered distributed log ingestion pipeline in Java and Spring Boot; processed 15k events/sec into Elasticsearch with real-time Slack alerting triggered within 5 seconds.

title: Distributed Key-Value Store with Raft Consensus
problemStatement: Single-point-of-failure storage solutions cannot survive node partitions in mission-critical environments. Build a replicated distributed key-value cluster from scratch implementing the Raft consensus algorithm.
architecture: Pure Go implementation of the Raft consensus protocol: Leader Election (heartbeats, term increments, split-vote resolution), Log Replication (entries committed across majority quorum), and Safety invariants. Features persistent state storage on disk.
scaleTargets: Maintain uninterrupted cluster reads and writes during failure of 2 out of 5 cluster nodes with linearizable consistency guarantees.
verificationRubric: Jepsen-style automated partition chaos test simulating network split-brain
Leader election unit test demonstrating automatic failover within 300ms
Write-ahead log (WAL) persistence ensuring recovery after crash restarts

portfolioBulletFormula: Implemented distributed Raft consensus state machine in Go from scratch; achieved linearizable consistency and sub-300ms leader election failover during simulated network partitions.

title: Zero-Trust API Security Gateway with JWT Rotation
problemStatement: Microservices are vulnerable to token theft, replay attacks, and compromised credentials when relying on long-lived API keys. Build a Zero-Trust gateway enforcing asymmetric JWT rotation, IP fingerprinting, and blacklisted revocation.
architecture: Express/Node.js edge proxy that verifies incoming client requests against RS256 public keys, validates dynamic fingerprint hashes, checks Redis revocation bloom filters in < 1ms, and signs downstream service-to-service mTLS tokens.
scaleTargets: Validate 10,000 auth tokens/sec with sub-2ms overhead while instantly revoking compromised user sessions across all instances.
verificationRubric: Public-private keypair (RS256) rotation workflow without user service disruption
Immediate session revocation endpoint using Redis fast key-expiry
Automated security suite testing against replay attacks, tampered signatures, and expired tokens

portfolioBulletFormula: Built Zero-Trust API gateway in Node.js & Redis utilizing RS256 token rotation; enforced instantaneous session revocation across 10k req/sec with < 2ms latency overhead.

title: Offline-First Mobile & Web Local-Sync Protocol
problemStatement: Field workers and mobile users frequently lose internet connectivity, leading to dropped changes and stuck form submits. Build an offline-first data synchronization protocol with client-side optimistic mutations and server vector clock conflict resolution.
architecture: Client stores mutations in local IndexedDB / SQLite with Lamport logical timestamps. When network connectivity resumes, an event sync engine batches mutations to a GraphQL backend which resolves conflicting updates via Last-Write-Wins or custom merge functions.
scaleTargets: Queue 1,000 offline mutations locally, syncing back to server in < 2 seconds upon reconnection with 100% deterministic conflict resolution.
verificationRubric: Interactive demo toggle simulating online, offline, and high-latency 3G connections
Conflict resolution visualizer showing simultaneous changes from two browser windows
Automated test suite validating vector clock incrementation and re-sync ordering
Persistent offline store maintaining integrity across browser refreshes

portfolioBulletFormula: Implemented offline-first synchronization protocol in React & TypeScript with IndexedDB; enabled seamless queued writes and sub-2s vector clock conflict resolution upon reconnection.
